classification_statement: Magnetic-topology screening of prescribed vacuum field maps under the HEMP/DCFT literature definition of a wall cusp (axis null -> separatrix -> dielectric-wall intersection). The L1a design sets are linear-vacuum equivalent-current screening fields (not P2-qualified, not hardware-valid); the single P2 row is the qualified divergent-exit-stack FEM field. No number here is a plasma, mirror-probability, wall-loss or performance claim; cells and mirror ratios are geometric field descriptors for consumers that carry this label.
purpose: Test whether the accepted L1a designs (and the sealed four-cell v2 candidates and characterization v1 cases) exhibit multi-cell wall-cusp topology under the literature definition, after the frozen v1/v2 definition (a wall-side X-type vector null with prominence/separation criteria) returned 0/56 and 0/128 by construction: in a periodic-permanent-magnet stack the vector nulls sit on the axis and the wall cusp is where the separatrix emanating from an axis null meets the dielectric wall.
relation_to_prior_nulls: The paper's Section 8 nulls (CLM-018..028, CLM-044/052) remain true under their frozen definition; this campaign tests a different, literature-standard definition on the same and larger design sets and records the result at its own outcome. No v1/v2 artifact is edited.

literature_basis.citation: Gildea, S. R., Development of the plasma thruster particle-in-cell simulator to complement empirical studies of a low-power cusped-field thruster, Ph.D. thesis, MIT, 2012
literature_basis.used_for: point cusps on the axis where each ring-cusp separatrix intersects the centreline; the field strength goes to zero only there; a separatrix is the surface on which the magnetic vector potential is zero valued

literature_basis.citation: Kornfeld, G., Koch, N., Harmann, H.-P., Physics and Evolution of HEMP-Thrusters, IEPC-2007-108, 2007
literature_basis.used_for: three magnet rings define four plasma cells separated by three neutral or cusp flux lines

literature_basis.citation: Koch, N. et al., The HEMPT Concept - A Survey on Theoretical Considerations and Experimental Evidences, IEPC-2011-236, 2011
literature_basis.used_for: PPM stack of axially magnetised rings in opposite magnetisation; cusps at the magnet ends; the exit cusp is formed by the stray field of the last magnet

literature_basis.citation: Lewerentz, L., Schneider, R., Simplified Optimization of the Magnetic Configuration of HEMP-Thrusters, Applied Sciences 13(6), 3491, 2023
literature_basis.used_for: field lines traced from the axis region until they hit the ideal wall r = R; separatrix; mirror ratio B_max/B_0 between the on-axis start point and the wall end point as the configuration descriptor

literature_basis.citation: Parnell, C. E., Smith, J. M., Neukirch, T., Priest, E. R., The structure of three-dimensional magnetic neutral points, Physics of Plasmas 3, 759-770, 1996
Haynes, A. L., Parnell, C. E., A method for finding three-dimensional magnetic skeletons, Physics of Plasmas 17(9), 092903, 2010
literature_basis.used_for: separatrix construction by field-line tracing from null eigen-directions

literature_basis.citation: Murphy, N. A., Parnell, C. E., Haynes, A. L., The appearance, motion, and disappearance of three-dimensional magnetic null points, Physics of Plasmas 22(10), 102117, 2015
literature_basis.used_for: null counts depend on resolution near degenerate configurations; cross-resolution correspondence

axis_null.statement: A point (0, z_k) on the symmetry axis where B_z(0, z) changes sign; B_r == 0 on the axis identically. Detected as a sign change of B_z(0, z) = 2 g(0, z) between consecutive samples (grid nodes plus the window ends) of the C1 axis-regular bicubic interpolant of g = (psi - psi_axis)/r^2 (orbit_mc PsiBicubicField, the accepted orbit v4/screening interpolant), refined by bisection until the bracket width is <= axis_root_bracket_tolerance_m; an exact node zero counts only when the neighbouring nonzero values have opposite signs (a tangency is not a null).
axis_null.search_window: [max(z_grid_min + axis_window_margin_mesh_factor*mesh, straight_z_min - axis_window_pitch_factor*pitch), min(z_grid_max - margin, chamber_length + axis_window_pitch_factor*pitch)], computed from the ACCEPTED map's mesh and reused verbatim for the refined map
axis_null.classification: the topology characterization v1 Jacobian/winding-index classification (imported unchanged from experiments.cft_topology_characterization_v1.experiment.local_topology with its frozen parameters: central finite differences of the symmetry-extended (B_r, B_z) on the bilinear map at steps 1.5 and 0.75 mesh cells, maximum relative Jacobian change 0.3, determinant tolerance 1e-3 of the Frobenius scale, winding index on a circle of 2 mesh cells with 32 samples, index tolerance 0.25) AND the analytic Jacobian of the bicubic interpolant (J = [[dBr/dr, dBr/dz], [dBz/dr, dBz/dz]] at the null; on the axis J = diag(-g_z, 2 g_z) so every simple axis null is X-type with eigen-directions e_r (separatrix) and e_z (axis); the divergence identity 2 J_rr + J_zz = 0 is recorded as a residual)
axis_null.convergence_criteria: bracket width <= 1e-12 m within 200 bisections (converged=true), v1 jacobian_converged=true, v1 classification == analytic classification == X; anything else is recorded and fails the every_null_converged gate

separatrix.statement: The field line leaving the axis X-null along its radial eigen-direction, seeded at (seed_radius_cell_fraction*dr, z_k) and integrated in the direction that increases r (sign of B_r at the seed) with the event-aware RK4 field-line integrator scheme of coupling v4 (RK4 on the unit field direction with fixed arc-length step trace_step_cell_fraction*min(dr, dz); a wall crossing by any RK stage halves the step, at most wall_event_max_halvings times; the endpoint is snapped to r = r_w when within wall_tolerance_m), sampling the C1 bicubic interpolant. Termination classes: wall (reaches r = r_w), domain_z (leaves the axial extent of the map), null (|B| below null_field_floor_relative * max|B|), step_limit, wall_event_unresolved, degenerate_seed.
separatrix.wall_intersection_record: z_c, |B|(r_w, z_c), B_r (wall-normal component), B_z, angle to the wall normal atan2(|B_z|, |B_r|), path length, step count, psi drift along the trace
separatrix.flux_root_cross_check: the separatrix is the g = 0 contour of the axis-regular flux variable, so z_c must coincide with the root of psi(r_w, z) - psi_axis nearest to z_c on the same interpolant within trace_flux_root_tolerance_m (binding integrity check)
separatrix.existing_integrator_comparison: the same trace repeated with cft_revival.coupling.v4_records._rk4_step on the bilinear grid map (the v4 field-line step); its wall intersection is reported per trace (not gated: a different interpolant)

wall_cusp_and_cell.cusp: a separatrix-wall intersection with straight_z_min <= z_c <= straight_z_max (the straight cylindrical dielectric; z = straight_z_min is the anode plane for the L1a sets and the start of the regular field domain for the P2 row; z = straight_z_max is chamber.exit_start, the end of the straight dielectric). Intersections outside are recorded with zone anode_side / divergent_exit / downstream_stray_field (the literature's exit cusp when downstream of the last magnet).
wall_cusp_and_cell.boundary_ambiguity: a cusp or intersection within boundary_ambiguity_tolerance_m of straight_z_min or straight_z_max is flagged boundary_ambiguous (reported; the refinement-stability gate is evaluated on the wall intersections, not on their inside/outside classification)
wall_cusp_and_cell.cell: the wall interval between consecutive cusps (interior), plus [straight_z_min, z_c,1] (anode_partial) and [z_c,K, straight_z_max] (exit_partial); a design without any cusp has one unbounded cell
wall_cusp_and_cell.mirror_descriptors: wall_mirror_ratio = min(|B|(r_w, z_c) over the cell's bounding cusps) / min |B|(r_w, z) over the cell (wall_samples_per_cell + 1 samples); wall_mirror_ratio_strong_end uses the stronger cusp; axis_mirror_ratio = min cusp |B| / max |B_z(0, z)| over the axis interval between the generating nulls (Lewerentz R_m with r_0 -> 0; the literal minimum of |B| on the axis between two nulls is zero at the nulls by definition and is therefore not a descriptor). Partial cells use the neighbouring axis null outside the straight section when one lies in the window, else the section end.
wall_cusp_and_cell.legacy_target: four_wall_cusps := exactly four cusps inside the straight dielectric (the v2 requirement of four geometry-registered cusps); four_cells := exactly four cells (three cusps) as in Kornfeld's three cusp lines / four plasma cells

stability.statement: Every design is characterized on its accepted map and on a refined map (L1a sets: the same discrete problem re-solved with 2x radial and axial intervals; P2: the level-2 FEM checkpoint on a 2x regular grid). stable := identical axis-null count in the shared window AND identical number of wall-reaching separatrices AND max |dz_k| <= stability_tolerance_m AND max |dz_c| <= stability_tolerance_m (sorted correspondence).
stability.held_out_checks: characterization_v1: every sealed v1 primary-map axis root inside the plasma channel must match a v3 axis null within held_out_tolerance_m with the same X classification, and every v3 channel null must match a v1 root (binding); sweep_v2: every sealed axis_null_positions_m entry inside the v3 window must match a v3 null within held_out_tolerance_m and vice versa (binding); the sweep's 'axis cusp' QoI is the local maximum of |B_z| on the axis (stage centres), NOT a null - its count per cell is reported

definition_v3.tracing_grid_rule: radial nodes 0..first node >= wall radius (at least three radial cells across the bore) and the full axial extent of the solved map; the interpolant is built with the solver's B_r/B_z as reference maps (5 % consistency check of PsiBicubicField)

sweep_v2.why: the accepted L1a geometry sweep v2 designs, the same 96 fields as the wall-loss geometry screening; re-solved with the screening's identity-proven CPU pipeline (rebuilt case hashes == sealed raw record, QoI replay under the sweep's tolerances, node-wise agreement for the four stored representatives)

four_cell_v2.why: the sealed candidate set of the preregistered four-cell topology search v2 IS reproducible from its sealed records (sampling identities, source and material hashes equal the dataset for 128/128; the geometry hash equals the dataset once the recorded CRLF-era protocol byte hash is substituted into the geometry evidence note, as disclosed in the v2 POSTHOC_AUDIT), so the literature definition is evaluated on exactly the designs that returned 0/128 under the frozen v2 definition
four_cell_v2.source: modern/experiments/four_cell_topology_search_v2/results/dataset.json (sidecar and payload integrity verified) and representatives v2-006, v2-010
four_cell_v2.note: the v2 candidates carry alternating_strength_ratio in [0.16, 0.42] (even stages weaker than odd stages) and first_polarity +1; their axis topology is therefore not that of an equal-strength PPM stack

characterization_v1.why: the 56 cases of the topology characterization v1 are the held-out reference for the axis-null machinery: v1 already recorded the clustered axis roots with Jacobian classifications on the same geometries (equal-strength alternating stacks of 2-8 stages); v3 must find the same nulls
characterization_v1.source: modern/experiments/cft_topology_characterization_v1/results/dataset.json (manifest identity verified) and the seven stored representatives

p2_divergent_exit.why: the P2-qualified divergent-exit-stack FEM field (iron poles and return yoke; the field of orbit v4 and of the PIC steady-state runs) tests the definition on a non-L1a field; it is a P2-qualified row, not an L1a screening row
p2_divergent_exit.source: modern/experiments/cft_orbit_wall_loss_v4/protocol.json#field_adapter (hash-bound level-1 and level-2 checkpoints under modern/examples/fem_reference)
p2_divergent_exit.geometry: cft_revival.geometry.generators.divergent_exit_stack (wall 2 mm, straight dielectric to exit_start 18 mm, chamber 24 mm, four stages at 3/9/15/21 mm, pitch 6 mm)

consistency_references.pic_axis_null_planes_source: pic2d steady-state dashboard cusp planes (B_z sign change on the axis of the sampled P2 field map)
consistency_references.role: consistency check reported per cusp; not a gate

representatives_with_paths: sweep_v2: the screening's four representatives; four_cell_v2: v2-006, v2-010; characterization_v1: the seven v1 representatives; p2_divergent_exit: the single row. Every other design stores separatrix endpoints and diagnostics without the sampled path.

per_set_and_pooled: cusp distance to the nearest inter-magnet gap centre vs to the nearest stage centre
consistency: P2 wall cusps vs the topology dashboard's wall |B_r| maxima and the PIC axis-null planes (differences reported, not gated)

binding_integrity.all_declared_designs_resolved: every declared design rebuilt, identity-proven and solved/sampled on both maps (no exclusions)
binding_integrity.every_null_converged: every axis null in every map: converged bracket, v1 Jacobian converged, X classification agreeing with the analytic Jacobian
binding_integrity.every_trace_terminates_cleanly: every separatrix trace on every map terminates as wall or domain_z (no null, step_limit, wall_event_unresolved, degenerate_seed)
binding_integrity.every_wall_trace_flux_consistent: every wall-reaching trace agrees with the flux root within trace_flux_root_tolerance_m
binding_integrity.held_out_correspondence: characterization_v1 and sweep_v2 axis-null correspondences hold for every design of those sets
binding_integrity.determinism_replay: re-characterizing the replay designs in the main process reproduces the worker's canonical topology bytes exactly, and re-solving their accepted fields reproduces the field identity
binding_integrity.hash_bindings: protocol, experiment code, dependency sources, field pipeline sources and sealed-source identities equal the preregistered authorities

catalogue.consumer_contract: one entry per design (set_id, design_id, label, geometry, axis nulls, wall cusps with z_c/|B|/angle, cells with z_start/z_end/kind/mirror descriptors, stable flag) so the geometry screening's launch design and the MDO closures can define cells by actual separatrix intersections instead of channel fractions; consumers must carry the entry's label (SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_SEPARATRIX_CUSP_TOPOLOGY or P2_QUALIFIED_FIELD_SEPARATRIX_CUSP_TOPOLOGY) and must not read the mirror descriptors as probabilities
catalogue.loader: experiments.cusp_topology_search_v3.catalogue.load_catalogue (validates the schema and every entry against the bundle manifest)

shakedown.purpose: Exercise the complete production path (design binding, identity proofs, CPU re-solves at both resolutions, tracing grids, bicubic interpolants, axis nulls, v1 classification import, separatrix traces, flux-root cross-check, v4 bilinear comparison, cells, stability, held-out correspondence, gates, catalogue, publication through the shared ExperimentRuntime into a temporary root, validate_bundle) on REAL designs of every set before the preregistration freeze.
shakedown.design_rule: first, median and last of the sorted sweep list (000 is a representative, exercising the stored-map path); the two stored v2 representatives; the smallest and largest v1 representatives; the P2 row (the only row of its set, so its topology is known before the freeze and is reported as such)
prepare_requires: experiment_code_sha256, dependency_source_sha256 and field_pipeline_source_sha256 equal the current sources

execution.cpu_budget_note: at most 12 of the 24 logical CPUs; the GPU runs a PIC case and is not touched; every solve is cft_revival.fields.solve_problem_cpu
execution.parallel_determinism_rule: each design's record is a pure function of (protocol, design identity); workers return canonical payloads with their SHA-256; the main process re-solves and re-characterizes the replay designs and requires byte-identical canonical topology payloads

per_design: artifacts/designs/<set>/<design_id>.json (identity, solver evidence, both characterizations, stability, held-out comparison; separatrix paths for representatives only)
artifacts/fields/<set>/<design_id>.json.gz (accepted tracing grid r, z, psi, Br, Bz as gzip of canonical JSON; its payload SHA-256 is recorded in the design record)

claim_boundary.field_level: L1a linear-vacuum equivalent-current FDM for sweep_v2 / four_cell_v2 / characterization_v1 (not P2, not hardware-valid); P2 adaptive FEM with iron for the single divergent-exit-stack row
claim_boundary.definition_source: the HEMP/DCFT literature cited in definition_v3.literature_basis
claim_boundary.iron_sensitivity: not tested as a with/without comparison; the P2 row contains iron poles and a return yoke, the L1a rows contain none
usable_as: cell definitions for the wall-loss geometry screening's launch design (labelled)
input to the paper's Discussion on the Section 8 nulls (definition scope)

prior_campaign_disclosure.characterization_v1: 0 stable eligible cusps / 0 stable eligible cells over 56 designs under the wall-side X-null definition; 1276 clustered roots recorded; axis nulls found and excluded as descriptors
prior_campaign_disclosure.four_cell_v2: 0/128 stable four-cell candidates (TOPOLOGY_COUNT and TOPOLOGY_UNSTABLE for every candidate) under the frozen v2 definition
prior_campaign_disclosure.sweep_v2: 3-5 axis |B_z| peaks ('axis cusps') per design; axis nulls recorded as QoIs; no wall-cusp definition applied
prior_campaign_disclosure.paper: Section 8 (CLM-018..028) and Discussion (CLM-044, CLM-052) scope the nulls to the frozen cusp/cell definition
